voice_description: An original synthetic adult male receptionist with a neutral American English accent. Warm, calm and professional, with clear consonants, natural pauses and an unhurried conversational pace. Reassuring and attentive without sounding theatrical. Do not imitate a real person.
text: Hello, you are speaking with an AI receptionist. I can answer questions from our approved information and help you find an appointment. Before I book anything, I will read the details back and ask you to confirm them.
use: Owner-only noncommercial pilot listening and integration evaluation
